r:
nvreadpublic

Runs TPM2_NV_ReadPublic

-ha
NV index handle
[-nalg
expected name hash algorithm (sha1, sha256, sha384 sha512) (default no check)]
[-opu
NV public file name (default do not save)]
[-ns
additionally print Name in hex ascii on one line]
[-on
binary format Name file name] Useful to paste into policy

-se[0-2] session handle / attributes (default NULL)

01
continue
40
response encrypt
80
audit
